raw_segments.text: Well, sir, pursued Joe, this is how it were. I were at the bargeman Tothernite pip. Whenever
he subsided into affection, he called me pip, and whenever he relapsed into politeness,
he called me sir. When there come up in his shake heart, Pumblechuck. Which that same
identical, said Joe, going down a new track. Do comb my air the wrong way sometimes, awful,
by giving out up and down town as it were him which ever had your infant companionation,
and were looked upon as a play fellow by yourself.
